self_inflicted_errors_recorded.what: the r4 product tree was corrupted by a text-mode round trip
self_inflicted_errors_recorded.detail: Path.read_text/write_text doubled every carriage return (CR 897 -> 1794, i.e. CRCRLF) while leaving the content correct, so a diff with CR stripped showed only the intended changes and looked entirely normal
self_inflicted_errors_recorded.fix: rebuilt on bytes, with the inverse reconstruction as the proof
self_inflicted_errors_recorded.generalisation: text-mode round trips are the wrong instrument for a file whose line endings are part of its identity -- and in this repo they are, because the tree's sha256 is registered

self_inflicted_errors_recorded.what: the first r4 measurement leaked state between candidates
self_inflicted_errors_recorded.detail: the candidate that rebinds the module's global pattern ran first, so the tree-as-it-stands candidate read that same rebound pattern; the report therefore said fix B changed nothing when in fact it closes the non-letter family
self_inflicted_errors_recorded.fix: the import-time pattern is captured before any candidate runs
self_inflicted_errors_recorded.generalisation: sharing a mutable global across a set of candidates silently merges the control with the treatment, and it does not error -- it produces a table that looks discriminating and is not

self_inflicted_errors_recorded.what: the first r4 harness build used write_text and rewrote every line ending
self_inflicted_errors_recorded.fix: write bytes, never through text mode
